先在“设置 → 添加模型服务”选择服务商，填写自己的 API Key 和模型。保: In Settings → Add model service, choose a provider and enter your API key and model. Save, tap the model name at the top of the chat to select a model, then type and send your question.
点击输入框的“+”添加图片或文档；图片需要支持视觉的模型。点击或按住麦克风可转写: Tap “+” in the composer to add images or documents. Images require a model with vision support. Tap or hold the microphone to transcribe speech, then send the text when ready.
在“设置 → 用户文档（USER.md）”填写称呼和回答偏好；在“管理长期记忆”: Add your preferred name and response preferences in Settings → User document (USER.md). View, edit or delete memories in Manage long-term memory.
聊天右上角的更多菜单可打开当前会话文件；在“设置 → 备份与恢复”导出备份或使用: Open the chat’s top-right menu to browse its files. In Settings → Backup and restore, export a backup or use HUAWEI Cloud. Model API keys are not included in backups.
检查服务地址、模型名称、API Key 和网络连接。失败提示会保留在聊天中，可修: Check the service URL, model name, API key and network connection. Error messages remain in the chat so you can fix the issue and retry. Check your provider for quota and billing details.
Tinybot 直接连接你选择的模型服务。请先准备服务商提供的 API Key；: Tinybot connects directly to your chosen model service. Have your provider’s API key ready; that provider determines model usage fees and quota.
打开“设置 → 添加模型服务”，选择服务商或自定义服务，填写地址、API Key: Open Settings → Add model service. Choose a provider or custom service, enter the URL, API key and model, then save. Return to the chat and tap the model name at the top to select your model.
直接输入你想解决的问题，也可以通过“+”添加材料。发送后可随时停止生成；需要多个: Type the problem you want to solve, or add material with “+”. You can stop generation at any time. For multiple assistants working together, type /team followed by your goal.
AI可能会犯错，请仔细鉴别。重要信息请核实来源；需要保留资料时，可从聊天更多菜单: AI can make mistakes. Verify important information against its sources. Export conversations from the chat menu or create a backup in Settings to keep your work.

新增工具编排，可组合文件、网页与 MCP 工具，统一汇总结果；展开工具回执可查看: Tool orchestration combines file, web and MCP tools into one result. Expand receipts to inspect each child call, its arguments, status and output, with cancellation and error recovery.

Categories are local estimates; reported request and turn usage is shown separately.
